articles.title: Doceree Sets the Global Standard for Healthcare Marketing, Building the World's Largest Network of Specialist Medical Publishers
articles.mainIdea: Doceree Sets the Global Standard for Healthcare Marketing, Building the World's Largest Network of Specialist Medical Publishers
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Doceree Sets the Global Standard for Healthcare Marketing, Building the World's Largest Network of Specialist Medical Publishers. Doceree, the only AI-powered Operating System for healthcare marketing, today announced a defining industry milestone: the creation of the world's largest network of specialist medical publishers, connecting more than 2,000 premium medical, clinical, and professional publishing platforms with endemic healthcare advertisers through its healthcare-native AI platform suite.

articles.title: CME Group to offer cardano, chainlink, stellar futures as institutions seek regulated risk-management tools
articles.mainIdea: CME Group to offer cardano, chainlink, stellar futures as institutions seek regulated risk-management tools
articles.summary: CoinDesk: CME Group to offer cardano, chainlink, stellar futures as institutions seek regulated risk-management tools. The new futures contracts, available in micro and standard sizes, are set to launch on Feb. 9, pending regulatory approval. Related tickers mentioned: ADA-USD, LINK-USD.
